Steps.Title: Exclude emergency access accounts from Conditional Access
Steps.Summary: Emergency access accounts can still sign in when a Conditional Access policy goes wrong.

Sources.Note: Exclude the emergency access accounts, ideally through one group, from every policy that blocks or restricts sign-in, and test that they can sign in.

Steps.Title: Exclude directory sync accounts from Conditional Access
Steps.Summary: The accounts that Microsoft Entra Connect and Cloud Sync use keep syncing when new policies apply.

Sources.Note: With Microsoft Entra Connect or Cloud Sync, exclude the Directory Synchronization Accounts role from policies that target all users.

Steps.Title: Require a compliant device in Conditional Access
Steps.Summary: Sign-ins from devices that Intune does not mark compliant are blocked.
Rollout: Create the policy in report-only mode and review the sign-ins it would block.
Turn it on for a pilot group.
Turn it on for all users, keeping the emergency access accounts excluded.

Sources.Note: The policy doesn't work as intended without an Intune compliance policy. Create one first, have at least one compliant device, and start in report-only.
A device can be marked compliant only once it is registered in Microsoft Entra ID and enrolled in Intune or a supported partner.
